name: Inspection train 4
displayDescription:
🌟 About This Legendary Train 🌟

Real-Life Heritage:
The Inspection Train 4 is one of Indonesia's most prestigious railway vehicles, used exclusively by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) executives and government officials for:

- Infrastructure Monitoring - Critical railway system inspections across the archipelago
- VIP Transportation - High-level diplomatic and business travel
- Private Charter Services - Luxury tourism experiences for distinguished guests

This isn't just any train - it's a mobile command center that represents the pinnacle of Indonesian railway operations.

Note :
This model represents one of Indonesia's rarest active trains. This model hasn't been updated in a long time due to limited public access and classified operational nature, detailed references are extremely scarce.
